summary: Phase 7 · Batch B (Fixes 0, 6, 7, 8) end-to-end verification. BACKEND — 5/6 pytest PASS, 1 skipped (list endpoint doesn't surface trip_id; auto-post still verified via idempotency). Invoices list has second filter row 'All Types / Formal (GST) / Informal (Cash)' and existing invoices show 'GST INVOICE' type badges. critical_code_review_comments: server.py:676 (before fix) had an unconditional `.split(':',1)[1]` that assumed audit_source contained a colon. The middleware sets it to bare 'manual' when no user tag is present, causing IndexError → 500. Safe fix: `_src.split(':',1)[1] if ':' in _src else None`. This pattern appears only in the new PATCH endpoint; other places already guard correctly.

Fix 7 auto-post logic is well-scoped: `should_post_ledger` requires status transition (not just status==completed) AND absence of existing ledger_entry_id — this is what makes the second PATCH a no-op. Good.
Fix 6 shipments/new payload now sends customers[], carriers[], bags[] arrays alongside legacy fields (party_id, party_ids, carrier_party_id, freight, freight_currency). Backward compatible.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the CRITICAL Fix 7 bug: server.py trips_patch() computed `modified_by = request.state.audit_source.split(':', 1)[1]` without checking for the ':' — the auth middleware sets audit_source to 'manual' when the X-Entry-Source header is bare. list.split(':', 1) returns ['manual'] (length 1), and index [1] raises IndexError. FastAPI converts this to a 500 with no client-visible detail. Reproduction (pre-fix): POST /api/trips → 200 with id; PATCH /api/trips/{id} with {status: 'completed'} → 500. Fix: guard on `':' in _src`. Applied and verified via /app/backend/tests/test_phase7_batchB.py (all 3 Fix-7 tests green after restart).
